title: 第二十三章 进藏书阁第二十四章 找到答案
content_zh:
姜云的感觉何其敏锐，刚出山谷就察觉到了那矮胖男子正在偷偷窥视着自己，虽然自己发现了，但是对方反应也很快，钻入了山谷之中。
此刻陆笑瑜也已经进入了谷中，在没有人带领的情况下，姜云也不敢贸然闯入阵法，所以沉吟了片刻后，只能转身离开。
只是在心中，他已经记下了那矮胖男子的模样，并且推测对方虽然身为杂役，不大可能是陷害陆笑瑜的人，但是两者之间，应该有着一些关联。
¤z¤
“算了，现在以我的身份，也没办法去多管闲事，不过好在，宗内虽然允许同门切磋，但严厉禁止互相杀戮，就算真有人要找笑瑜的麻烦，至少她也不会有性命之忧！”
对于出身莽山的姜云来说，问道宗的门规，就如同莽山的规矩，那是绝对不容任何人破坏和违背的，所以他对于陆笑瑜的事情，还并不是太过担心。
只是刚出莽山的他并不知道，在这个世界，规矩是死的，而人，却是活的。
甚至，有人完全可以凌驾于规矩之上！
将陆笑瑜的事情暂时抛开，姜云再次来到了藏书阁，径自走入了大门。
一入大门，姜云就如同进入了另一个世界，耳畔寂静无声，只有轻微的书页翻动之声，而呈现在他眼前的是一座方碑，碑上只有寥寥数行字，写的是关于藏书阁的介绍。
藏书阁共分七层，除去第一层是对宗内所有人开放之外，从第二层开始，进入其内就需要至少具备外门弟子的身份。
自然，层数越高，所需要的身份也就越高，每个人每年只准进入三次，如果想要多次进入，就需要以贡献点来换取。
藏书阁内严禁打斗，禁止喧哗，其内所有书籍也只能在这里观看，不得随意带出，当然，如果有贡献点的话，有些书籍还是可以复制一份带走的。
姜云匆匆的将方碑上的介绍看完之后，就越过了方碑，正式进入了藏书阁。
第一层的面积极大，虽然其内有着数百名弟子，但是却并不显得拥挤，四周分门别类的摆放着一排排的书架，而每个书架之中都有着或多或少的书册。
每一个书架的上方，都写着几个字，指明了书架上的书是属于哪一方面。
粗粗看去，这第一层，大概有超过万本的书册。
虽然这个数量让姜云暗自咂舌，但这实际上是极为正常的，毕竟关于修道的知识实在是太多太多，而每个人对于修道的任何一个方面都有不同的见解，故而流传的书册内容和数量也是极为繁多。
只是这些书并没有什么太大的价值，故而每个宗门都会收集这样类似的藏书，供门下弟子阅读，增长见闻知识。
姜云并没有着急选书，而是先大致的将第一层整个都浏览了一遍之后，这才走向了自己所需要的书架，找到了一本厚重的书册！

这本书中的内容记载的是关于修道的类型和大致的分类标准。
随着姜云不断的翻动着书册，看着书上对于修道的种种介绍，他的脸色也是逐渐的一点点的阴沉了下去。
当整整一天的时间过去之后，姜云终于轻轻的合上了这本书册，将其放回了书架，转过身去，一言不发的大步走出了藏书阁，走向了藏峰。
一路之上，姜云始终都是面色阴沉，保持着沉默，只是疾步行走。
甚至，哪怕他清楚的感觉到了身后有人跟踪着自己，他也懒得回头看上一眼，直至来到了藏峰之下。
“站住！”
content_en:
Jiang Yun's senses were so keen that he noticed the short, fat man peeking at him as soon as he left the valley. Although he noticed it, the other party reacted quickly and got into the valley.
At this moment, Lu Xiaoyu had also entered the valley. Without anyone to lead him, Jiang Yun did not dare to rush into the formation, so after pondering for a moment, he could only turn around and leave.
But in his mind, he had already memorized the appearance of the short, fat man, and speculated that although the man was a handyman and unlikely to be the one who framed Lu Xiaoyu, there should be some connection between the two.
¤z¤
"Forget it, with my status now, I can't meddle in other people's business, but fortunately, although the sect allows fellow disciples to compete, they strictly prohibit killing each other. Even if someone really wants to cause trouble for Xiao Yu, at least her life will not be in danger!"
For Jiang Yun, who was born in Mangshan, the Taoist sect's sect rules are just like the rules of Mangshan. They are absolutely not allowed to be broken or violated by anyone, so he is not too worried about Lu Xiaoyu's matter.
But he just came out of Mangshan and didn't know that in this world, rules are dead, but people are alive.
There are even people who can completely override the rules!
Putting Lu Xiaoyu's matter aside for the time being, Jiang Yun came to the library again and walked directly into the door.
As soon as he entered the gate, Jiang Yun felt as if he had entered another world. There was silence in his ears, except for the slight sound of turning pages. What appeared in front of him was an obelisk with only a few lines of words on it, which was an introduction to the library.
The Library Pavilion is divided into seven floors. Except for the first floor, which is open to everyone in the sect, starting from the second floor, one needs to be at least an outer disciple to enter.
Naturally, the higher the level, the higher the identity required. Everyone is only allowed to enter three times a year. If you want to enter multiple times, you need to exchange for contribution points.
Fighting and making noise are strictly prohibited in the library pavilion. All books in the library can only be viewed here and cannot be taken out at will. Of course, if there are points of contribution, some books can still be copied and taken away.
After Jiang Yun hurriedly read the introduction on the obelisk, he crossed the obelisk and officially entered the library pavilion.
The first floor is very large. Although there are hundreds of disciples inside, it does not seem crowded. There are rows of bookshelves arranged in different categories, and each bookshelf contains more or less books.
Above each bookshelf, there are a few words written on it, indicating which category the books on the shelf belong to.
At a glance, there are probably more than 10,000 books on this first floor.
Although this number made Jiang Yun secretly smack his lips, it was actually extremely normal. After all, there was so much knowledge about Taoism, and everyone had different opinions on any aspect of Taoism, so the content and number of books circulated were also extremely large.
It's just that these books don't have much value, so every sect will collect such similar books for their disciples to read and increase their knowledge.
Jiang Yun was not in a hurry to choose a book. Instead, he roughly browsed the entire first floor before going to the bookshelf he needed and found a thick book!
The content in this book records the types and general classification standards of monasticism.
As Jiang Yun continued to flip through the book and read the various introductions to Taoism in the book, his face gradually became gloomier.
When a whole day passed, Jiang Yun finally closed the book gently, put it back on the bookshelf, turned around, and strode out of the library without saying a word, heading towards Zangfeng.
Along the way, Jiang Yun always looked gloomy, remained silent, and just walked quickly.
Even if he clearly felt someone following him behind him, he didn't bother to look back.Eyes, until they came to the hidden peak.
"stop!"
